scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. I see that your loan application has been approved. The loan was purchased by Fannie Mae.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! What is the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 7.5%. The total costs associated with the loan are $12,027.85.

dialogue.user: 7.5% seems a bit high. Are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: No, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Got it. What is my debt-to-income ratio and what does it mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. This ratio compares your monthly debt payments to your monthly income.

dialogue.user: I see. What type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help. <Satisfied> - The agent was polite and provided clear answers to my questions, even though some details were not available.
